ideas.pitch: An automated cryptographic puzzle solver that breaks classical ciphers, frequency-analysis anomalies, and common RSA padding flaws instantly.
ideas.problem_statement: Decode encrypted information and solve cryptographic puzzles.
ideas.title: CryptoCracker Pro
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly tackles the cryptography challenge category with hard algorithmic engineering instead of relying on generic prompts.

ideas.pitch: An automated open-source intelligence gathering toolkit that aggregates metadata, EXIF data, and public social traces into an interactive geospatial investigation board.
ideas.problem_statement: Investigate publicly available information to discover clues.
ideas.title: OSINT-Map Explorer
ideas.why_it_could_win: Combines a hard data-scraping and multi-source pipeline with an intuitive detective UI, standing out in the OSINT track.

ideas.pitch: A digital forensics and steganography workbench that detects hidden payloads in images and audio using LSB analysis and discrete Fourier transforms.
ideas.problem_statement: Find hidden information concealed within files or digital media.
ideas.title: StegaVision Analyzer
ideas.why_it_could_win: Delivers genuine technical depth in steganography and forensics, solving the exact problem criteria judges will test against.

ideas.pitch: An automated web exploitation scanner and visualizer that identifies SQLi, XSS, and broken access controls in vulnerable sandbox web apps.
ideas.problem_statement: Identify and solve security-related challenges in web applications.
ideas.title: WebVuln Hunter
ideas.why_it_could_win: Adopts the high-impact security telemetry pattern from winning infrastructure apps to impress judges evaluating web exploitation.

ideas.pitch: A real-time collaborative CTF operations platform featuring shared flag submission tracking, automated Docker sandbox instances, and integrated write-up generators.
ideas.title: CTF Team Intel Hub
ideas.why_it_could_win: Solves the actual operational bottleneck of competing in a CTF event, giving teams a competitive edge with exceptional workflow polish.
